- Overestimate prices in bullish sentiment periods (positive sentiment > 0.10) — reduce forecast by 5–10% for high sentiment days.
- Underestimate prices during negative sentiment (sentiment < -0.30) — add 3–7% to forecast to account for risk aversion or market panic.
- Overshoot after sharp price spikes (e.g., +10%+ in 3–5 days) — cap forecast at 10% below peak for next 5 days.
- Mean-reversion bias: if forecast is >15% above 10-day moving average, reduce by 2–5% per day until convergence.
- Lagged forecast error: if true outcome is >10% higher than 7-day average, adjust forecast downward by 1–3% for next 3 days.
- Horizon-specific: 30-day forecasts tend to overestimate in early cycles — reduce by 2–5% if sentiment is neutral or mildly bullish.
